name: Image Print Size Calculator
description: Calculate physical print dimensions from pixel dimensions and print PPI.
search_intent: Calculate how large an image can print at a selected pixels-per-inch value.
calculation: Print width inches = pixel width / PPI. Print height inches = pixel height / PPI. Centimeters = inches × 2.54. Return null when PPI is zero or invalid.
limitations: PPI is pixels per printed inch; printer DPI is not the same measurement.
Perceived print quality depends on viewing distance, printer, paper and source quality.
